rationale: #419 G2: explicit constructor invocation (JLS 8.8.7) — super(...), this(...), and qualified Receiver.super(...) — is an explicit call edge and must be visible. Authored from semantics before observing analyzer run; proven failing pre-fix (G2), now pinned so it cannot regress. M37.21 C3: constructor symbols carry their CLASS NAME (CtorDelegation, not the old colliding literal 'constructor') so distinct classes' ctors and their overloads stay distinguishable.
